schema: data/moves v1 (style of throwdown.json): every number = {v, basis}; basis = sample id + skeleton field + frame/time
conventions: ref angles: knee 0 = straight, torso_lean 0 = upright, arm_abd 0 = arm hanging, elbow 0 = straight (MediaPipe skeleton). game.* knee = interior angle (180 = straight) as in rider.js. t = clip time (0 = user segment start).
segment_notes: 1.8 s user segment = 2 push strokes with the RIGHT (rear) foot, left foot on the board (vision on the mp4 + skeleton: right ankle reaches forward of the hip and drops to ground level ~0.43-0.5 s, moves back relative to the hip until ~0.77 s (world x -0.11 -> +0.58 m, travel = image left), lifts, swings forward again, second contact ~1.5-1.77 s). Support (left) knee bend and torso lean peak inside each contact. Recovery swing is HIGH: right ankle 0.30 m above the left at f4 with knee_R ~90 deg.

stance.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 refskel stance(): travel method, 100% agree with view.stance; vision confirms right foot pushes

cycle_s.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 ang.knee_L main peak f21 t0.6 -> next support-knee peak f53 t1.67 (one stroke per cycle)

contact_t0.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 world right ankle y reaches ground level (0.69-0.72 m below hip, = left/board ankle +-0.05) at f16-f18 t 0.43-0.5

contact_t1.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 world right ankle x most rearward +0.58 at f26 t 0.77, then lifts (f30 y 0.48)

support_knee_peak_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 ang.knee_L main peak f21 t0.6 (smoothed 57.8, raw 63.3, half-height 0.57..0.7)

support_knee_glide_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 ang.knee_L median between strokes over t 1.0..1.4

torso_lean_peak_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 ang.torso_lean main peak f20 t0.57 (smoothed 29.0, raw 29.4, half-height 0.5..0.7)

torso_lean_glide_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 ang.torso_lean median between strokes over t 1.0..1.4

recovery_knee_peak_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 ang.knee_R peak t<=0.4 (push leg recovery) f5 t0.07 (smoothed 79.1, raw 89.3, half-height -0.03..0.27)

recovery_foot_lift_m.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 world left_ankle.y - right_ankle.y at f4 t0.033 (+y down)

push_reach_fwd_m.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 world right_ankle.x at f16 t0.433 (plant point ahead of the hip; travel = -x)

push_reach_back_m.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 world right_ankle.x at f26 t0.766 (toe-off behind the hip)

arm_abd_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 ang.arm_abd_max median during contact over t 0.4..0.8

elbow_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_20 ang.elbow_L median during contact over t 0.4..0.8

game._: proposed values for rider.js startPush/pushAccel/stateWeights (push cycle T, contact window c0/c1, support knee, lean). Not wired yet.

c0.basis: ref.contact_t0 - recovery knee peak t0.07 (cycle start = push foot at its highest; rider.js now: c0 = 0.3*T)

kneeSupport.basis: 180 - ref.support_knee_peak_deg, capped at 45 deg flexion (Cheney: soft knee, long spine, no hunched dig; ref 58 deg)

recoveryLift.basis: ref.recovery_foot_lift_m = 0.30 m, capped at 0.08 (rider.js rule: recovery swing low ~5 cm; the reference skater swings high — Cheney to decide)
